integrity_notes: Analytic Lyapunov elimination and monotonic-ratio derivative prove the full parameter classification. The standalone rational program checks identities and a witness but is not a substitute for the quantified proof. No field or experimental data used.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time two-patch linear deviation model with independent additive Gaussian forcing and symmetric dispersal. Theorem applies to variance of the regional sum, not actual extinction probabilities, positivity-preserving population dynamics, local variance, correlated shocks, or higher-patch networks.
title: A unique intermediate-dispersal variance minimum in heterogeneous two-patch populations
